description.value: Kitsilano Liquor Store is a neighbourhood off-licence in the heart of the Kitsilano district, near the corner of West Broadway and Vine in Vancouver. It carries an extensive selection of beer, wine, and spirits and is known for personalized service and staff product knowledge. The store offers online ordering through Skip the Dishes, DoorDash, and Uber Eats for those who prefer delivery.
